tonight.headline: Nothing moved since 15:20 — Allgeier stays in the flex, McLaurin covers Monday
body: Bad news first: Alvin Kamara is still questionable with the back after three limited practices (Saints report, 16 Oct), and Jefferson and Gordon are on bye. Terry McLaurin was limited Thursday and rested Friday (Commanders.com 15 Oct); ESPN's 22:05Z file carries no designation for him.

That does not reopen the flex. Allgeier and McLaurin both project 12.4, a coin flip, and the order as set is the safe one: Allgeier plays Sunday 14:05, McLaurin Monday night, so if Allgeier is a surprise inactive at 12:35 Sunday you can still put McLaurin in. 127.0 projected against Bok-aneers' 112.5; ESPN 57%. Nothing to do.

case.label: Why leave it
case.body: A projection tie carries no thesis. Allgeier is Arizona's lead back with Jeremiyah Love OUT (NFL.com; ArizonaSports 16 Oct); McLaurin is cleared but practised only twice, limited. Either is the projection lineup.

case.label: The one Sunday check
case.body: Arizona's inactives, 12:35 CDMX. Allgeier carries no designation, so this is a formality — but McLaurin, kicking off Monday, is the only cover left unlocked by then.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Allgeier inactive at 12:35 Sunday: McLaurin into the flex. Otherwise nothing.
